recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, vibrant urban cartoon scene featuring anthropomorphic dogs in a backyard setting, characterized by a red brick wall backdrop, exaggerated character expressions, and integrated hand-drawn speech bubbles.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters interacting with a central red-roofed doghouse
Large-scale graffiti-style lettering integrated into the brick wall
Multiple secondary characters peering over the top edge of the wall
A human antagonist partially hidden on the right margin
coreInvariants: Red brick texture with black mortar lines
Anthropomorphic dogs wearing human clothing like flannel and jeans
Hand-drawn speech bubbles with jagged outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central dog character in a blue flannel shirt dominates the mid-ground, positioned atop a doghouse.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red roof of the doghouse in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular flow from the large top-left lettering, across the dogs on the wall, down to the human catcher on the right, and back to the central doghouse.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with detail, using the brick wall as a textured filler.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Brick red and deep blue (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow and white (doghouse base and speech bubbles)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright pink and green (accessories and grass)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with heavy black airbrushed shadows for depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Graffiti wildstyle and hand-printed comic script
letterConstructionRules: Top lettering uses thick yellow outlines with black fills and internal highlights
Background lettering is integrated into the brickwork as negative space or heavy black blocks
Speech bubble text is irregular, all-caps, and follows the curve of the bubble
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters 'O' often replaced or modified with eye-like pupils
Terminals on large letters are sharp and elongated
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive display lettering paired with jittery, hand-drawn dialogue text.
graphicDevices: Action lines around tails and hands

preserve: Yellow/Black color scheme for main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban street aesthetic of the primary display text
Matches the dialogue and speech bubble style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban backyard scene with a red brick wall, a red-roofed doghouse on green grass, and several cartoon dogs with exaggerated expressions wearing 90s streetwear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn graffiti lettering in yellow and black across the top and integrated into the brick wall, with jagged speech bubbles containing hand-printed text.

verificationChecks: Ensure the brick wall has a hand-drawn, irregular texture
Check that characters have thick black outlines
Verify that the color palette is saturated and uses airbrush-style shading
Confirm the lettering feels like part of the illustration rather than a digital font

adjustableVariables: Time of day (night sky vs day)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Gritty but vibrant comic book feel

postGenerationChecks: Is the brick wall texture consistent across the frame?
Do the speech bubbles feel integrated into the scene?
Is the central character the clear focal point?
Are the colors vibrant and high-contrast?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Satire Illustration = (90s Comic Art Style + Anthropomorphic Characters) * (Graffiti Typography + Brick Wall Environment)
